emergent.config.title: Emergent Options
emergent.config.missing_cloth_config: Install Cloth Config API to edit Emergent options in game. Server and manual configuration still use config/emergent.json.
emergent.config.preset.tooltip: Applies a curated feature set when you save. Use Custom to keep the toggles below unchanged.
emergent.config.volatile_containers.tool: Containers holding explosive items can react to fire and explosions.
emergent.config.volatile_dropped_items.t: Dropped explosive items can ignite, detonate, and chain-react.
emergent.config.volatile_inventories.too: Entities carrying explosive items can react when damaged by fire or explosions.
emergent.config.reactive_creepers.toolti: Creepers can react more dynamically when hurt.
emergent.config.infinite_fire_spread.too: Fire spread remains aggressive instead of aging out normally.
emergent.config.burning_entity_fire_spre: Burning entities can spread fire into nearby blocks.
emergent.config.wetness_fire_dampening.t: Rain, stored moisture, waterlogged blocks, and nearby water reduce fire spread and ignition.
emergent.config.passenger_momentum_trans: Dismounting from moving vehicles carries some of the vehicle's momentum into the passenger.
emergent.config.kinetic_impacts.tooltip: Fast vehicles, falling blocks, and moving entities can damage living things and add structural stress to fragile blocks.
emergent.config.ballistic_inertia.toolti: Airborne living entities, vehicles, falling blocks, and dropped items keep more physically believable trajectories with mass-based air drag.
emergent.config.universal_warden_summoni: Sculk shriekers are allowed to summon wardens in more places.
emergent.config.dynamic_experience.toolt: Living-entity XP rewards use a body-energy model, which also feeds vanilla sculk catalyst charge.
emergent.config.finite_water_flow.toolti: Water and lava conserve volume instead of creating infinite source blocks.
emergent.config.rain_accumulation.toolti: Rain wets surfaces first, then can form shallow puddles when the surface is saturated enough.
emergent.config.hydraulic_erosion.toolti: Flowing water can erode vulnerable terrain, carry sediment, and deposit material downstream.
emergent.config.auto_planting.tooltip: Dropped plantable items can settle into suitable nearby blocks.
emergent.config.material_reactions.toolt: Tag-driven block reactions for fire, rain, growth, heat, ash, traffic wear, and material stress.
emergent.config.boundless_enchanting.too: Spends enchanting and anvil costs as raw XP energy, removes anvil caps, combines stored enchantment work, and lets supported over-cap effects spend that work.
emergent.config.unrestricted_enchantment: Allows mutually exclusive enchantments to coexist, such as Protection variants or Sharpness with Smite.
emergent.config.boundless_brewing.toolti: Lets redstone repeatedly extend potion duration and glowstone repeatedly raise potion strength.
emergent.config.smoke_and_fumes.tooltip: Fires, lava, and explosions emit smoke that obscures vision and can suffocate entities in enclosed spaces.
emergent.config.pressure_explosions.tool: Explosions in confined spaces can hit harder than equivalent blasts in open air.
emergent.config.structural_stress.toolti: Unsupported stone, sandstone, and dirt can crack, crumble, or cave in after nearby explosions.
emergent.config.fire_ecology.tooltip: Fire can leave scorched soil and occasional charcoal or sticks, and rain can slowly restore burned ground.
emergent.config.water_lava_steam.tooltip: Water touching lava can produce steam that damages and pushes nearby entities.
emergent.config.chemistry_reactions.tool: Dropped items can react with water, fire, and soil based on chemistry tags.
emergent.config.creature_panic.tooltip: Animals and villagers flee nearby fire, lava, and recent explosion smoke.
